answer_2.quote: We use three metrics to measure the bias of the training data ... Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence ... MAUVE ... MTLD ... BT Discrepancy Rate ... Accuracy ...

answer_4.quote: Two annotators manually check the percentage of the BTs which are not semantically equivalent to their original utterances.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess whether each back‑translated utterance preserves the same meaning as the original utterance.
